notes.title: 🚀 New Update: Bug Fixes, Improvements, and Exciting New Features! 🌟
notes.notes:
🚀 New Update is Live! 🌟


In this week’s regular update, we’ve included bug fixes and improvements along with some exciting new features! Here’s what’s new:

✅ Visibility of Distant Objects Fixed: The issue of distant objects like sky trains suddenly appearing has been fixed! They are now visible continuously based on distance settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/edbf3a4acf5b2c13e8cad1f976814ae021f30691.png[/img]

✅ Big Map Improvement: The big map that opens with the G or M key now loads in fullscreen! Bigger, more strategic, and easier to use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/d86fad12554ef0e7c3a140ba2a3adf84d6520263.png[/img]

✅ Chat Panel Fix: The issue of usernames and text overlapping in the chat panel has been fixed. Enjoy a cleaner and more organized chat experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/1344a35e8c6c51d71230f67c2fd44fc21da4a61b.png[/img]

✅ Chest Drop Rate Update: Fish and egg drop rates have been reduced. Now, with more balanced drop rates for a better gaming experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/0fee324ea9601db0cd66272a0eee45c510093b5f.png[/img]

✅ Stone Finding Rate Improved: For players who had issues finding stones, we've heard you! The stone finding rate has been increased by 65%, so you'll find stones more frequently now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/40c7854768f16942b9bae22a16d35a64435d6c34.png[/img]

✅ New Robot NPCs in the Spacestation: We’ve added robot NPCs that roam and repair the environment. Your space station is now more fun and lively!


Come on, update now and explore the new features! 🚀🌌


💬 Join our community: [Discord Server Link https://discord.com/invite/Uxgkk84MVS]

notes.title: Venator Universe - HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Dear Venator Universe Community,

Since our launch, we have carefully reviewed all your positive and negative feedback, working tirelessly to provide solutions for each issue. Here are the updates we've implemented sequentially:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/4e1f48ad9be78459e70df45d0c9cfd89d7ba08e8.png[/img]

Enjoy your game,
The Venator Universe Team

notes.title: Venator Universe: Hotfix Update - Better, Fairer!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Venator Universe players! Today's update is a quick fix for the issues encountered during yesterday's initial launch. Here's a rundown of all the changes:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/4e1f48ad9be78459e70df45d0c9cfd89d7ba08e8.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Hunger and Thirst Balance: Now you can survive longer.
[*] NPC and Creature Damages: Adjusted unbalanced damage from units.
[*] Loot Distribution: All world loot has been reviewed for fairness.
[*] Starting Fairness: Problems with class selection and item spawning at the start have been fixed.
[*] Item Durability: Item durability has been recalibrated.
[*] Building Damage: Adjusted structure damage rates.
[*] Map Change Ticket: The ticket system has been removed.
[*] Store Visuals: Misleading store visuals have been revamped.
[*] Galactica PvP Map: Explore our new PvP map through the Map Selector!
[*] Shovel Activation: Now you can gather from all surfaces.
[*] Starting Point: The entire world map is set as the starting point.
[*] Quest System: Completely revamped.
[*] Path Tracing Shadow: Removed.

[*] Starting Armor: Level 1 armors added to the character creation list.

[/list]

[b][h3]Important Note: Following these critical changes, all player save files have been reset. For a clean and fair start, you will need to create your character again.[/h3][/b]

With this update, we aim to make your gaming experience fairer, more enjoyable, and smoother. Keep playing, and we look forward to hearing your feedback!

notes.title: New Update: Enhanced Gameplay and Xbox Controller Support!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, brave explorers of Venator Universe[/h2]

[h1]We're excited to announce that our latest update introduces several new features to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what's new:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/aced46f826bd3c942c95dedf3b04ca467e696e7d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Xbox Controller Support: 🎮 Now, immerse yourself in the game with the comfort of your Xbox controller.
[*] Meet The Drifters: 🌍 Introducing "The Drifters" - characters you can interact with. While initially friendly, you wouldn't want them as foes. Defeat them for rich loot, but be warned, they're not easy targets!
[*] Revamped Trading System: 🚀 In our Spacestation, traders have been organized into categories for your convenience:
[*] Weapons Trader 🗡️
[*] Armor Trader 🛡️
[*] Furniture Trader 🛋️
[*] Farming Trader 🌾
[*] General Goods Trader 🛒
[*] Trade Manager 📊
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/ee4c59aa72f47cacbc674151bd6fc2c7c506117c.png[/img]
Each trader specializes in initial items for their category, allowing for a swift start or unique trading strategies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884388/e6b3b0ac2d9e598949a2002d2dd10dd4cdf7ef70.png[/img]
Trader Compass Icons: 🧭 For easier navigation, Compass icons have been added for all trader NPCs. Find them under the Yellow Basket symbol in Spacestation for category-specific shopping.

[h1]Special Focus: The Trade Manager[/h1]

The Trade Manager introduces a dynamic trading mechanism where you can buy and sell exotic plants, minerals, and ancient relics from different planets or distant lands. 🌌💰 For instance, AnticRelic might be selling for 1300 Coins on Galactica but could fetch 1700 Coins on Planet Quantix. 

Risk-taking traders can buy in bulk and transport goods to where they're more valuable, turning a profit. However, keeping an eye on the daily market fluctuations is crucial for maximizing your gains.

Dive back into [Game Name] and experience these new features. Whether you're looking to engage in combat, trade, or simply explore, there's something for everyone in this update.


Your adventure awaits, enhanced and ready for you. Let us know what you think about these updates!

Happy gaming and may your ventures be fruitful! 

VenatorUniverse Team

notes.title: Update Packed with New Features!
notes.notes:
Hello dear players,

We have exciting news for you! With our latest update, we've added a host of new features and improvements to the game. Here are the details:

[b]Dodge and Roll System[/b]: You can now move more effectively in combat. Gain the upper hand against your foes with agile movements.

[b]Compass Added[/b]: Fear no more about losing your way! With our new compass, you'll reach your destination with ease.

[b]Home Marker[/b]: To easily locate your home, placing an area marker now adds a home icon to your map. No more getting lost!

[b]Safe Zones[/b]: Safe zones have been introduced for when you need a break. No one can harm you here, making it perfect for logging out safely.

[b]Sleep Mode[/b]: When you exit the game, your character will enter sleep mode. Hunger and thirst levels remain stable, allowing you to pick up right where you left off upon your return (provided you haven't died).

[b]New AIs and Bosses[/b]: To enrich your gaming experience, we've added new AI enemies and bosses. They'll be tougher to defeat, but the rewards will be worth it!

With this update, we aim to elevate your gaming experience. Dive into the game now to explore these new features and don't forget to share your feedback with us. Your opinions are crucial in making our game even better.

Keep playing and survive!
[Game Name] Team

notes.title: Venator Universe V5: Major Update Is Here!
notes.notes:
Dear Venator Community,

We are excited to announce the release of the V5 update! This version brings significant improvements, focusing not only on new features but also on optimization. Here's what's new in V5:

-General Updates and Improvements:-

140 icons have been completely revamped.

All ores and textures have been redesigned from scratch.

-New Traps Added:-

Bear trap has been added.

Landmine has been added.

-Throwable Weapons and Tools:-

Throwable Knife

Throwable Pickaxe

Throwable Axe

Throwable Shovel

Grenade (Timed explosion)

Grenade (Instant explosion)

-You now have more explosives to destroy walls:-

C4-like sticky bomb with a remote detonator has been added.

-Animations:-

Emote animation menu has been added.

5 new emote animations have been included.

-Building System Updates:-

Repair feature has been added.

Pick up from ground feature has been added.

-New Weapons:-

16 new weapons have been added:

Spear, katana, great sword, shuriken, long axe, hammer, mace, and more.

-Revamped Models:-

Furnace, crusher, alchemy table, table, coffee table, and many other models have been redesigned.

-Equipment and Armor:-

2 new backpacks have been added.

20 new headgear pieces have been added, providing more visual and equipment options.

30 new armor and clothing pieces have been added.

-Interface and User Experience:-

The entire UI has been redesigned to be more user-friendly.

Character selection screen and camera angle have been changed.

-Created characters are now divided into two categories:-

Full suit characters: These are models wearing full armor.

Non-suit characters: Fully customizable characters of your own design.

-Important Notice:-

-Safe Zone and Logout Changes:-

Weapons can no longer be used in safe zones, and building is not allowed.

When players log out, their characters will now enter sleep mode and remain vulnerable to attacks while still present in the game. This means it's crucial to log out only in safe zones. Players need to be more strategic when logging off !

notes.title: Patch Updates Now Live!
notes.notes:
- Map Transition Fix: The issue of visual distortion during map transitions (preloading visual glitch) has been resolved with a loading screen. The loading screen will no longer be removed until the map is fully loaded.

- Mission System Fix: The bug related to the mission system being inactive has been fixed. Missions are now distributed at the space station.

- Placement Fix: Issues where certain actors such as the Furnace, Alchemy Table, and Fridge would place in a wooden house but not in a stone house have been resolved.

- Mineral Drops Fix: The issue of minerals like Flint, Enchant Stone, Enchant Crystal, and Coal dropping from every mine on Earth has been fixed. Additionally, Flint has been removed.

- New Barricades: Newly added barricade types like Wooden Stakes and Survival Shield have been added to the production template.

notes.title: Major Performance and Visual Improvement Update
notes.notes:
- Resolved Space Station Shadow Issue: Fixed the problem where shadows were overlapping and causing visual issues in the space station.
  
- Campfire Model Updated: The primitive campfire model has been replaced with a more aesthetic version.

- Fixed Complex Collision Issues with Trees: Simplified the unnecessarily complex collision structure of trees.

- Nanite-Compatible Material Adjustments: Adjusted material conditions to be compatible with Nanite usage.

- World Map Optimization: Achieved a 40% performance increase in the world map through optimizations, with no loss in game quality.

We continue to work on providing a better gaming experience in Venator Universe. Enjoy your new adventures!

notes.title: Major Update - Buildings, UI, and More!
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Players,

With our new update, many exciting new features and improvements are now available! Here are the details:

Building Mechanic
The building mechanic has been completely revamped and now features a 3-tier upgrade system. You can upgrade your structures to Tatch, Wooden, and Stone. This allows you to build stronger structures and better protect your home.

User Interface and Icons
To improve the user experience, we have made significant changes to our interface. All icons have been updated with more user-friendly designs. Navigating and interacting within the game is now much easier and more enjoyable.

Planet World Map
We have made adjustments to the amount of resources available on the Planet World map. Berry resources can now be found more abundantly. This change will make your resource gathering process more efficient.

We believe this update will make your gaming experience more enjoyable and fun. Don't forget to share your feedback and opinions with us!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Update Notes
Dear Players,
We are excited to bring you a new update! We have made significant improvements to enhance your gaming experience, and we are thrilled to share the details of this update with you.

New Features and Improvements:
1. Completely Overhauled Animation System

The entire animation system of the game has been redesigned from the ground up. Character movements, combat scenes, and environmental interactions are now smoother and more realistic. With this update, your in-game experience will be more dynamic and immersive.
2. Interface Improvements

Various improvements have been made to the game interface. Menus are now more user-friendly, and the overall design has been updated to offer a more modern and aesthetic look. You will find everything you need in the game more easily now.
We look forward to your feedback on these updates. Thank you for your support, and happy gaming!
